briefing: Stocks rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.2% and the S&P 500 up 1.6%, led by semiconductor, AI-infrastructure and crypto-related names. Our lessons say to put idle cash to work on strong risk-on days, so we're placing a small buy in EQPT, the top-scoring candidate. We're holding all seven current positions and letting the automatic profit targets and stop-losses manage the exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, and out of safer ones. You can usually spot it when the NASDAQ, which is heavy in tech, rises more than the broader S&P 500, as it did today (+2.2% vs +1.6%). These days are often a good time to put idle cash to work, but you should still pick stocks that aren't already overbought.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，願意把資金從較穩健的資產轉投科技股等高風險、高增長的資產。常見的跡象是以科技股為主的納斯達克指數升幅大於標普500指數，正如今日的2.2%對1.6%。這類日子通常適合把閒置資金投入市場，但仍應避開技術指標已顯示超買的股份。

market_education.summary_en: Today was a broad risk-on day: the NASDAQ rose 2.2% and the S&P 500 rose 1.6%, so investors were clearly willing to pay up for growth. Most of the top momentum names (MU, AMD, LITE, SNDK, DELL, SMCI) are semiconductor, memory and AI-hardware companies, which points to continued money flowing into the AI-infrastructure theme. Bitcoin-mining and crypto-linked stocks (MARA, WULF, CIFR, GLXY) also turned bullish together, a sign of strong speculative appetite. No headlines came with today's data, so this explanation is based only on index and sector price action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場全面轉向風險偏好，納斯達克指數上漲2.2%，標普500指數上升1.6%，反映資金積極追捧成長股。動能榜前列幾乎都是半導體、記憶體及AI硬件股（如MU、AMD、LITE、SNDK、DELL、SMCI），顯示資金持續流入AI基建主題。比特幣礦企及加密貨幣相關股份（MARA、WULF、CIFR、GLXY）亦同步轉強，可見市場投機情緒高漲。由於今日未有新聞標題輸入，以上分析僅根據指數及板塊的價格走勢。

trades.reasoning: EQPT has the highest score (95) and every signal agrees: RSI of 58.4 is healthy with room to run, MACD has crossed above its signal line with a rising histogram, and the price is above its 20-day average, which makes it the best fit for the small cash left on a risk-on day.
